$comment: Gate 24 measurements (tests/browser/first-paint-gate.browser.mjs) that fail for a reason outside the first paint, each with that reason. Reported by every run, not counted; an entry that passes again is reported under knownNowPassing and is taken out.

known.page-header/path-and-action: The page gives the header a <sf-button> with its label as text («Создать»); text cannot be held out of view beside a picture, so the action button shows its text for the frames until its own code draws it (shift 0.0006). A server prints the label as the button's text setting.
known.range-slider/tooltip: Found when phase A of standard 1.4 (2026-10-28) gave examples.json its object form and the gate measured this example for the first time (it drew the defaults before): the printed slider is 48 px (44 at 390) and the adopted one 54, the value bubble above the handle taking its room only once the code draws it. A first-paint defect of sf-range-slider, queued to its thread; the snapshot is what the build prints.
known.site-header/documentation: Found when sf-site-header 1.0.0 was first measured (2026-10-28): the header's own box holds (73 px at 1280, 61 at 390 in every phase), but the tools row shifts by 0.0014-0.0018 when the search sf-button (icon and a text setting) is drawn by its code -- the printed button and the drawn one differ in width by a fraction of a pixel. A first-paint defect of sf-button with icon-start and text, queued to the Framework thread; the catalogue example, whose tools are sf-color and the theme switch, holds still.
